limitations: The six-second exit is a last-trade mark at or before the target time, not a proven executable sell fill.
The operating threshold is selected on this validation partition, so this is not an independent final estimate.
The 25x negative sampling weight estimates population metrics but cannot recover omitted-token path dependence.
Missing and later-than-target entries are reported explicitly; actual delay can exceed requested delay.
single_hypothesis: the training-only target-wallet median hold of six seconds can serve as a fixed replica exit rule under 0/1/2-slot entry and observed training fee sensitivity
